title: Not sure how to feel about this.
text: Not sure how to feel about this.. The concept for this shoe rack is cool. I definitely liked the fact that I'm able to make adjustments as needed and it was easy enough to figure out how it's  assemble but there were way too many bent tubes so the whole time I'm struggling just to force the pieces together. I did manage to finish assembling the rack but since a lot of the pieces were damaged, it was almost impossible to expand the rack to the size I needed. Also, the rack MUST be pulled at the exact same time or it pulls unevenly so I needed my partner to help pull and keep it lifted of the floor. Like I said before, cool concept but too many negatives.
